name: Island of Violets
source: On the island of Themiscyra, you are Lyra, princess and warrior. All your life, you’ve fought an addiction to forbidden desires, craving touch, bodies, and intimacy that could destroy you. When you meet Thebe, a disobedient recruit, you take control of her training, breaking her down until she learns to obey. As your power over her grows, you find yourself drawn deeper into this dangerous game. One day, a miracle occurs that will reshape Themiscyra and force you to question everything you’ve ever known.
